research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: The title Modular system for upstream wastewater sampling and its abstract describe a wastewater sampling system with an inlet tube, outlet port, high flow circuit, pump, and sampling circuit configured to collect representative upstream wastewater. Biobot Analytics is researching and developing modular systems that improve how wastewater is sampled and routed, supporting reliable collection of sewage for population level health analysis, wastewater monitoring, and upstream wastewater sampling infrastructure.

overview_description.description: Biobot is the pioneer and market leader in wastewater epidemiology intelligence with a mission to deliver population-level health insights across various infectious diseases and high risk substances. Customers include federal, state and local governments, pharmaceutical companies, universities, and more. Founded at MIT in 2017, Biobot's vision is that healthcare intelligence is inclusive and proactive.

about_short_description.short_description: Real-time, privacy-first health intelligence. The world's first and most advanced wastewater intelligence platform.

product.name: Wastewater Epidemiology Data Platform
product.description: A platform that analyzes sewage samples to provide population-level health insights by detecting pathogens and substances in wastewater.

product.name: Wastewater-Based Variant Sequencing
product.description: A service that sequences viral genetic material in wastewater to identify and monitor emerging virus variants in communities.

product.name: Respiratory Virus Surveillance Reports
product.description: Weekly reports analyzing wastewater data on respiratory viruses to inform public health about trends and viral activity.

identifier.value: High-Risk Substance Use Monitoring via Wastewater

product.name: High-Risk Substance Use Monitoring via Wastewater
product.description: A service that detects and quantifies illicit drugs and other high-risk substances in wastewater to inform public health and harm reduction strategies.

product.name: Biobot public wastewater dashboard
product.description: A public dashboard displaying wastewater-based genomic surveillance data for over 1,500 human and animal viruses across multiple cities.
